meaning: A picture works if it shows the 10,106 dogs truthfully and readably as its own title, subtitle and caption promise: the colours, the order, the axis labels and the stated count of 'unbestimmt' coats all agree with the drawing and with the register.

items.why: Almost every square is the same grey, so no coat colours show, the caption's 1,325 hollow squares don't match the drawing, and the stray clipped label '3408–9764' means nothing.
The colours are scattered at random with no year labels and only a clipped '3408–9764' label, so it doesn't show the order the subtitle promises (by birth year, dark to light within each year).
Each year is labelled and runs from dark to light, and the 2,729 hollow squares are clearly the unnamed coats, piling up from 2025 on, exactly as the caption says.
Every square is uniform grey, so no coat colour is shown, and the caption's 461 hollow squares contradict the 2,729 'unbestimmt' entries in the register.

Every square is grey and the caption claims 0 'unbestimmt' dogs, so the colours and the central fact are both missing.
The dogs are sorted by colour across the whole register instead of by birth year, there are no years, and a stray 'männlich' label sits at the edge.
Rows for each birth year run from dark to light with the year boundaries marked, and the 2,729 hollow squares sit where the caption says they do.

Stacked columns by birth year with correct counts, dark to light, with dotted hollow squares for the 2,729 'unbestimmt' coats, as the subtitle explains.
